title: RoleBinding inheritance shadowing in Private clusters leading to cross-tenant role bleed and missing audit entries
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Multiple enterprise Private customers reported an escalation where users from one tenant temporarily received roles from another tenant after an IdP group rename combined with a control-plane rolebinding inheritance path. Simultaneously, several audit events related to those accesses were missing downstream because the audit-processor dedup filter suppressed cross-tenant events when the roleowner metadata field was empty. This ticket tracks an urgent security fix: stop unscoped inheritance from crossing tenant boundaries, rehydrate missing audit metadata, and deploy a short-lived compatibility shim during KMS envelope rewrap windows.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure two Private tenants A and B with a shared control-plane that uses group-to-role mapping via SAML attribute 'groups'.
2) Prepare a rolebinding in tenant B that is marked as 'inherits: control-plane' and references an external SAML group mapping key path.
3) Perform an IdP group rename/alias action that leaves the old attribute value present in the SAML assertion for a transient window (IdP replay/alias behavior noted in customer logs).

4) Trigger a user login from tenant A that contains the renamed group alias; observe that rolebinding resolution code mistakenly treated the alias as belonging to tenant B due to a canonicalization mismatch and inherited binding applied cross-tenant.
5) Check audit pipeline: the access event is emitted, but the audit-processor dedup stage drops it because roleowner metadata was empty for inherited, cross-tenant bindings.
6) Reproduce in staging by simulating IdP assertion replay and running the control-plane role resolution job with --inherit-check=false to compare behavior.
observed_behavior: Cross-tenant role grants for short windows (few seconds->minutes) after IdP group rename
Missing or suppressed audit events for those cross-tenant accesses downstream in the analytics cluster
KMS envelope rotation in some clusters correlated with an increased frequency of stale roleowner metadata due to rewrap lag
expected_behavior: RoleBinding inheritance should be strictly scoped to the tenant namespace that owns the binding
Audit events should contain tenant and roleowner metadata and not be dropped by dedup filters
KMS rotations should not create windows where control-plane metadata becomes stale
root_cause_summary: Two interacting issues: (1) canonicalization mismatch in SAML group attribute processing allowed legacy aliases to be matched against rolebinding targets without verifying tenant ownership, and (2) the audit-processor dedup heuristic dropped events when roleowner was missing; that field became empty for inherited bindings during KMS rewrap latency because the metadata rehydration job failed to complete before audit writeback.
mitigation_plan: Backout path: roll control-plane to previous version with tenant-scoped checks if the patch causes regressions
Short-term hotfix: add tenant-ownership validation in role resolution path that rejects inherited bindings crossing tenant boundaries (server-side guard)
Audit fix: change dedup rule to not suppress events missing roleowner and instead tag them for 'audit-repair' downstream
Customer-facing mitigation: coordinate with impacted customers to rotate affected SSH/credential bindings and run a scoped permission sweep
KMS: schedule forced incremental rewrap job for clusters with pending envelope rotation to shorten rewrap window
implementation_notes: Patch touches control-plane role resolution: validate that the resolved rolebinding.namespace == request.tenant_id before granting inherited roles
Add unit tests covering SAML attribute aliasing and tenant scope enforcement
Instrument a meter for 'cross-tenant-inherit-attempts' and a counter for 'audit-dropped-metadata'
Add a compatibility shim: when KMS rewrap is detected and metadata rehydration is not complete, temporarily block inheritance rather than allow empty roleowner
Code owners: infra/authz team for role resolution, infra/audit for dedup rule change
Estimate: 2 days dev + 1 day QA + 0.5 day rollout; follow-on migration job for audit-replay estimated 3 days
rollout_notes: Canary deploy to 2 small Private clusters first (low-traffic customers) with feature-flag 'tenant-inherit-enforce' off initially
Flip flag to 'on' during quiet window; monitor 'cross-tenant-inherit-attempts' and 5xx rates
If canary stable for 60 minutes, incrementally roll to all Private clusters over 4 hours
For clusters with recent KMS rewraps, run the incremental rewrap job post-rollout
Prepare an emergency rollback playbook and automated runbook to revert control-plane deployment
qa_plan: Create integration test harness that simulates IdP alias-replay and verifies tenant scoping
Verify audit pipeline preserves events under heavy load: run end-to-end test with synthetic traffic and assert no drops
Smoke test both hosted and Dedicated control-plane code paths to ensure no regression
Security review: ARR (adversarial role resolution) test cases to ensure no bypasses
